mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ts_story_info WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status != 9) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ts_story_info WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR status != 9) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id AS id, s.title AS title, s.story_intro AS storyIntro, s.story_mode AS storyMode, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, COALESCE(st.follower_count, 0) AS followerCount, COALESCE(st.dialogue_count, 0) AS dialogueCount, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ts_story_info s LEFT JOIN ts_story_stat st ON st.story_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_public = 1 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9)
AND ( s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.story_intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND s.story_mode = #{storyMode}
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC
